CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_achievements(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_stats jsonb;
  v_existing text[];
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  -- Match first-request bootstrap without creating a daily assignment.
  with created as (
    insert into public.profiles(id, display_name)
    select p_user_id, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)
      from auth.users u where u.id = p_user_id
    on conflict(id) do nothing returning id
  )
  insert into public.user_topics(user_id, topic_id)
  select created.id, t.id from created cross join public.topics t where t.is_active
  on conflict do nothing;
  insert into public.notification_preferences(user_id) values (p_user_id)
  on conflict(user_id) do nothing;
  perform id from public.profiles where id = p_user_id for update;
  if not found then return null; end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(achievement_code), '{}'::text[]) into v_existing
    from public.user_achievements where user_id = p_user_id;
  perform public.edge_api_award_eligible(p_user_id);
  -- Awards discovered on collection are historical reconciliation, not a new tap.
  update public.user_achievements set source = 'history'
   where user_id = p_user_id and not (achievement_code = any(v_existing));
  v_stats := public.edge_api_stats(p_user_id);

  with counts as (
    select 'completed_concepts'::text as metric, count(*)::integer as value
      from public.user_concept_completions where user_id = p_user_id
    union all
    select 'completed_reviews', count(*)::integer from public.daily_reviews
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    union all
    select 'weekly_quizzes_completed', count(*)::integer from (
      select quiz_id from public.weekly_quiz_attempts where user_id = p_user_id group by quiz_id
    ) quizzes
    union all
    select 'weekly_perfect_scores', count(*)::integer from (
      select a.quiz_id from public.weekly_quiz_attempts a
      join public.weekly_quizzes q on q.id = a.quiz_id and q.user_id = a.user_id
      where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.correct_count = jsonb_array_length(q.questions)
      group by a.quiz_id
    ) quizzes
    union all
    select 'completed_subtopics', count(*)::integer from (
      select subtopic_id from public.user_subtopic_completions
      where user_id = p_user_id group by subtopic_id
    ) subtopics
  ), rows as (
    select d.*, a.earned_on, a.source, a.seen_at,
      case when d.metric = 'consecutive_days' then (v_stats->>'current')::integer
           else coalesce(c.value, 0) end as progress
      from public.achievement_definitions d
      left join public.user_achievements a
        on a.achievement_code = d.code and a.user_id = p_user_id
      left join counts c on c.metric = d.metric
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'code', code, 'metric', metric, 'threshold', threshold,
    'name', name, 'description', description, 'artwork_key', artwork_key,
    'category', category, 'requirement', requirement,
    'show_progress', show_progress,
    'progress', case when show_progress then least(progress, threshold) else null end,
    'earned_on', earned_on, 'source', source, 'seen_at', seen_at
  ) order by sort_order, code), '[]'::jsonb) into v_items from rows;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'current_streak', (v_stats->>'current')::integer,
    'longest_streak', (v_stats->>'longest')::integer,
    'items', v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_award_eligible(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with days as (
    select assigned_for as d from public.daily_assignments
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    union
    select assigned_for from public.daily_reviews
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
  ), streak_islands as (
    select d, d - (row_number() over(order by d))::integer as grp from days
  ), streak_facts as (
    select d as earned_on,
           row_number() over(partition by grp order by d)::integer as threshold
      from streak_islands
  ), concept_facts as (
    select completed_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by completed_at, concept_id)::integer as threshold
      from public.user_concept_completions where user_id = p_user_id
  ), review_facts as (
    select completed_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by completed_at, id)::integer as threshold
      from public.daily_reviews where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
  ), quiz_events as (
    select quiz_id, min(attempted_at) as occurred_at
      from public.weekly_quiz_attempts where user_id = p_user_id group by quiz_id
  ), quiz_facts as (
    select occurred_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by occurred_at, quiz_id)::integer as threshold
      from quiz_events
  ), perfect_events as (
    select a.quiz_id, min(a.attempted_at) as occurred_at
      from public.weekly_quiz_attempts a
      join public.weekly_quizzes q on q.id = a.quiz_id and q.user_id = a.user_id
     where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.correct_count = jsonb_array_length(q.questions)
     group by a.quiz_id
  ), perfect_facts as (
    select occurred_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by occurred_at, quiz_id)::integer as threshold
      from perfect_events
  ), subtopic_events as (
    select subtopic_id, min(completed_at) as occurred_at
      from public.user_subtopic_completions where user_id = p_user_id group by subtopic_id
  ), subtopic_facts as (
    select occurred_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by occurred_at, subtopic_id)::integer as threshold
      from subtopic_events
  ), facts as (
    select 'consecutive_days'::text as metric, threshold, earned_on from streak_facts
    union all select 'completed_concepts', threshold, earned_on from concept_facts
    union all select 'completed_reviews', threshold, earned_on from review_facts
    union all select 'weekly_quizzes_completed', threshold, earned_on from quiz_facts
    union all select 'weekly_perfect_scores', threshold, earned_on from perfect_facts
    union all select 'completed_subtopics', threshold, earned_on from subtopic_facts
  )
  insert into public.user_achievements(user_id, achievement_code, earned_on, source)
  select p_user_id, d.code, f.earned_on,
    case when f.metric in ('consecutive_days', 'completed_concepts') then 'completion'
         when f.metric = 'completed_reviews' then 'review'
         when f.metric in ('weekly_quizzes_completed', 'weekly_perfect_scores') then 'quiz'
         when f.metric = 'completed_subtopics' then 'subtopic' end
    from facts f
    join public.achievement_definitions d on d.metric = f.metric and d.threshold = f.threshold
  on conflict(user_id, achievement_code) do nothing
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_concept(p_user_id uuid, p_slug text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', c.id,
    'slug', c.slug,
    'title', c.title,
    'summary', c.summary,
    'example', c.example,
    'flashcard', c.flashcard,
    'topic_slug', t.slug,
    'topic_name', t.name,
    'subtopic_slug', s.slug,
    'subtopic_name', s.name,
    'like_count', (
      select count(*)::integer from public.concept_interactions ci
      where ci.concept_id = c.id and ci.liked_at is not null
        and ci.user_id <> p_user_id
    ),
    'content_version', c.content_version,
    'review', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'name', e.registered_name,
        'reviewed_at', e.created_at,
        'content_version', p.content_version
      )
      from public.editorial_publications p
      join public.editorial_revision_events e on e.id = p.approval_id
      where p.concept_id = c.id and p.content_version = c.content_version
        and p.snapshot = to_jsonb(c) - array['created_at', 'published_at', 'status']
        and e.concept_id = c.id and e.action in ('approved', 'attested')
    )
  )
  from public.concepts c
  join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
  join public.subtopics s on s.id = c.subtopic_id
  where c.slug = p_slug and c.status = 'published'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_candidate_problem(p_concept_id uuid, p_slug text, p_body jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_problem text;
  v_prereq text;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_body)<>'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_body->'curriculum')<>'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_body->'learning_package')<>'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_body->'learning_package'->'mcqs')<>'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(p_body->'learning_package'->'mcqs')<>3
    or length(coalesce(p_body->>'title',''))<3
    or length(coalesce(p_body->>'summary',''))<100
    or length(coalesce(p_body->>'example',''))<40 then
    return 'Lesson body is incomplete or invalid';
  end if;
  with recursive walk(slug,route,cycle) as (
    select prereq.value,array[p_slug,prereq.value],prereq.value=p_slug
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(
        p_body->'curriculum'->'prerequisites','[]'::jsonb)) prereq(value)
    union all
    select child.value,walk.route||child.value,child.value=any(walk.route)
      from walk
      left join public.concepts known_concept on known_concept.slug=walk.slug
      left join public.concept_backlog known_backlog on known_backlog.slug=walk.slug
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(
        known_concept.curriculum->'prerequisites',
        known_backlog.curriculum->'prerequisites','[]'::jsonb)) child(value)
      where not walk.cycle and cardinality(walk.route)<1000
  )
  select case when walk.cycle then 'Prerequisite cycle includes '||walk.slug
    when not exists(select 1 from public.concepts c where c.slug=walk.slug)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.concept_backlog b where b.slug=walk.slug)
      then 'Unknown prerequisite '||walk.slug end into v_problem
    from walk where walk.cycle or
      (not exists(select 1 from public.concepts c where c.slug=walk.slug)
        and not exists(select 1 from public.concept_backlog b where b.slug=walk.slug))
    limit 1;
  if v_problem is not null then return v_problem; end if;
  for v_prereq in select value from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(
    p_body->'curriculum'->'prerequisites','[]'::jsonb)) loop
    if not exists(select 1 from public.concepts c
      join public.topics t on t.id=c.topic_id and t.is_active
      join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id and s.is_active
      where c.slug=v_prereq and c.status='published') then
      return 'Publish prerequisite '||v_prereq||
        ' in an active topic and subtopic first';
    end if;
  end loop;
  select other.slug into v_problem from public.concepts other
    where other.id<>p_concept_id and other.status='published' and (
      pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(other.title),
        '[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')) =
      pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(p_body->>'title'),
        '[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g'))
      or pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
        pg_catalog.lower(other.curriculum->>'objective'),'[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')) =
      pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
        pg_catalog.lower(p_body->'curriculum'->>'objective'),'[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')))
    order by other.slug limit 1;
  if v_problem is not null then
    return 'Exact duplicate of '||v_problem||'; resolve overlap before publication';
  end if;
  return null;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_concept_detail_source(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_aal text, p_concept_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor jsonb;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  v_actor := public.edge_api_editorial_authorize_any(
    p_user_id,p_session_id,p_aal,array['review','approve','publish']);
  if v_actor ? 'error' then return v_actor; end if;
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id',c.id,'slug',c.slug,'status',c.status,
    'title',c.title,'summary',c.summary,'example',c.example,
    'curriculum',c.curriculum,'flashcard',c.flashcard,'mcqs',c.mcqs,
    'model',c.model,'prompt_version',c.prompt_version,
    'content_version',c.content_version,
    'subtopic_slug',s.slug,'topic_active',t.is_active,
    'subtopic_active',s.is_active,
    'snapshot',to_jsonb(c)-array['created_at','published_at','status'],
    'legacy_snapshot',(select l.snapshot from public.editorial_legacy_versions l
      where l.concept_id=c.id and l.content_version=c.content_version),
    'provenance',(select jsonb_build_object(
      'reviewer_id',e.actor_id,'registered_name',e.registered_name,
      'reviewed_at',e.created_at,'content_version',p.content_version)
      from public.editorial_publications p
      join public.editorial_revision_events e on e.id=p.approval_id
      where p.concept_id=c.id and p.content_version=c.content_version
        and c.status='published'
        and p.snapshot=to_jsonb(c)-array['created_at','published_at','status']
        and e.action in ('approved','attested') limit 1),
    'duplicate_slug',(select other.slug from public.concepts other
      where other.id<>c.id and other.status='published' and (
        pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(other.title),
          '[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')) =
        pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(c.title),
          '[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g'))
        or pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
          pg_catalog.lower(other.curriculum->>'objective'),'[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')) =
          pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
          pg_catalog.lower(c.curriculum->>'objective'),'[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')))
      order by other.slug limit 1),
    'unknown_prerequisite',(select prereq.slug from
      jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(c.curriculum->'prerequisites')='array'
        then c.curriculum->'prerequisites' else '[]'::jsonb end)
      with ordinality prereq(slug,position)
      where not exists(select 1 from public.concepts known where known.slug=prereq.slug)
        and not exists(select 1 from public.concept_backlog known where known.slug=prereq.slug)
      order by prereq.position limit 1),
    'unpublished_prerequisite',(select prereq.slug from
      jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(c.curriculum->'prerequisites')='array'
        then c.curriculum->'prerequisites' else '[]'::jsonb end)
      with ordinality prereq(slug,position)
      where not exists(select 1 from public.concepts required
        join public.topics rt on rt.id=required.topic_id and rt.is_active
        join public.subtopics rs on rs.id=required.subtopic_id and rs.is_active
        where required.slug=prereq.slug and required.status='published')
      order by prereq.position limit 1)
  ) into v_result
    from public.concepts c
    join public.topics t on t.id=c.topic_id
    join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
    where c.id=p_concept_id;
  if v_result is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('error','concept_not_found');
  end if;
  return v_result;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_generation_jobs(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_aal text, p_status text, p_topic_id uuid, p_concept_id uuid, p_cursor uuid, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor jsonb;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_next uuid;
begin
  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 100
     or (p_status is not null and p_status not in (
       'pending','generating','failed','ready_for_review','cancelled','superseded')) then
    return jsonb_build_object('error','invalid_page');
  end if;
  v_actor := public.edge_api_editorial_authorize(
    p_user_id,p_session_id,p_aal,'review');
  if v_actor ? 'error' then return v_actor; end if;
  with page as (
    select j.id,public.edge_api_editorial_job_public(j) as item
    from public.editorial_generation_jobs j
    where (p_status is null or j.status=p_status)
      and (p_topic_id is null or j.topic_id=p_topic_id)
      and (p_concept_id is null or j.concept_id=p_concept_id)
      and (p_cursor is null or j.id>p_cursor)
    order by j.id limit p_limit+1
  ), numbered as (
    select page.*,row_number() over(order by id) as position from page
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by id) filter(where position<=p_limit), '[]'::jsonb),
         (select id from numbered where position=p_limit
           and exists(select 1 from numbered where position>p_limit))
    into v_items,v_next from numbered;
  return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'next_cursor',v_next);
end
$function$

edge_api_editorial_generation_supply.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_generation_supply(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_aal text, p_topic_id uuid, p_floor integer, p_review_capacity integer, p_generation_enabled boolean, p_provider_configured boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor jsonb;
  v_active boolean;
  v_published bigint;
  v_drafts bigint;
  v_pending bigint;
  v_generating bigint;
  v_failed bigint;
  v_ready bigint;
  v_review_load bigint;
  v_target integer;
begin
  if p_floor is null or p_floor < 0
     or p_review_capacity is null or p_review_capacity < 1 or p_review_capacity > 250
     or p_generation_enabled is null or p_provider_configured is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('error','invalid_config');
  end if;
  v_actor := public.edge_api_editorial_authorize(
    p_user_id,p_session_id,p_aal,'review');
  if v_actor ? 'error' then return v_actor; end if;
  select is_active into v_active from public.topics where id=p_topic_id;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('error','topic_not_found'); end if;
  select
    (select count(*) from public.concepts c join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where c.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and c.status='published'),
    (select count(*) from public.concepts c join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where c.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and c.status='draft'),
    (select count(*) from public.concept_backlog b join public.subtopics s on s.id=b.subtopic_id
      where b.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and b.status='pending'
        and b.attempts<3+(select count(*) from public.content_retry_log l where l.backlog_id=b.id)),
    (select count(*) from public.concept_backlog b join public.subtopics s on s.id=b.subtopic_id
      where b.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and b.status='generating'),
    (select count(*) from public.concept_backlog b join public.subtopics s on s.id=b.subtopic_id
      where b.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and b.status='failed'),
    (select count(*) from public.concept_revisions r join public.concepts c on c.id=r.concept_id
      join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where c.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and c.status<>'archived'
        and r.base_version=c.content_version
        and r.status in ('draft','pending_review','changes_requested',
          'validation_failed','approved'))
    into v_published,v_drafts,v_pending,v_generating,v_failed,v_ready;
  select
    (select count(*) from public.concepts c join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where c.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and (c.status='draft' or
        (c.status='published' and exists(select 1 from public.concept_revisions r
          where r.concept_id=c.id and r.base_version=c.content_version
            and r.status in ('draft','generating','validation_failed',
              'pending_review','changes_requested','approved'))))) +
    (select count(*) from public.concept_backlog b join public.subtopics s on s.id=b.subtopic_id
      where b.topic_id=p_topic_id and s.is_active and b.status='generating')
    into v_review_load;
  select greatest(p_floor,coalesce(
    (select target_count from public.content_supply_targets
     where topic_id=p_topic_id and expires_at>now()),0)) into v_target;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'topic_id',p_topic_id,'active',v_active,
    'published',v_published,'drafts',v_drafts,'pending',v_pending,
    'generating',v_generating,'failed',v_failed,'ready_for_review',v_ready,
    'target',v_target,'review_load',v_review_load,
    'review_capacity',p_review_capacity,
    'review_blocked',v_review_load>=p_review_capacity,
    'planning_required',v_active and v_pending=0 and v_generating=0
      and v_published+v_drafts<v_target,
    'generation_enabled',p_generation_enabled,
    'provider_configured',p_provider_configured
  );
end
$function$

edge_api_editorial_job_public.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_job_public(p_job public.editorial_generation_jobs)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_stamp text;
  v_payload text;
begin
  v_stamp := public.edge_api_editorial_utc_iso(p_job.updated_at);
  -- Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) over the four
  -- version fields, with FastAPI's UTC datetime encoding.
  v_payload := format('{"attempts":%s,"id":%s,"status":%s,"updated_at":%s}',
    p_job.attempts, to_jsonb(p_job.id)::text, to_jsonb(p_job.status)::text,
    to_jsonb(v_stamp)::text);
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id',p_job.id,'source_revision_id',p_job.source_revision_id,
    'concept_id',p_job.concept_id,'topic_id',p_job.topic_id,
    'feedback_event_id',p_job.feedback_event_id,
    'request_event_id',p_job.request_event_id,'status',p_job.status,
    'attempts',p_job.attempts,
    'available_at',public.edge_api_editorial_utc_iso(p_job.available_at),
    'result_revision_id',p_job.result_revision_id,'failure_code',p_job.failure_code,
    'created_at',public.edge_api_editorial_utc_iso(p_job.created_at),
    'updated_at',v_stamp,
    'token',encode(pg_catalog.sha256(convert_to(v_payload,'UTF8')),'hex')
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_legacy_eligibility(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_aal text, p_topic_id uuid, p_configured boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor jsonb;
  v_count bigint;
  v_active_batch uuid;
begin
  v_actor := public.edge_api_editorial_authorize(
    p_user_id,p_session_id,p_aal,'request_generation');
  if v_actor ? 'error' then return v_actor; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.topics where id=p_topic_id and is_active) then
    return jsonb_build_object('error','active_topic_not_found');
  end if;
  select count(*) into v_count
    from public.concepts c join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
   where c.topic_id=p_topic_id and c.status='published' and s.is_active
     and (not exists(select 1 from public.editorial_publications p
            where p.concept_id=c.id and p.content_version=c.content_version)
       or length(btrim(coalesce(c.curriculum->>'objective','')))=0
       or c.curriculum->'difficulty' is null
       or case when jsonb_typeof(c.curriculum->'references')='array'
          then jsonb_array_length(c.curriculum->'references')=0 else true end
       or length(btrim(coalesce(c.flashcard->>'front','')))=0
       or length(btrim(coalesce(c.flashcard->>'back','')))=0
       or case when jsonb_typeof(c.mcqs)='array'
          then jsonb_array_length(c.mcqs)<>3 else true end)
     and not exists(select 1 from public.concept_revisions r
       where r.concept_id=c.id and r.status in
         ('draft','generating','validation_failed','pending_review',
          'changes_requested','approved'))
     and not exists(select 1 from public.editorial_legacy_batch_entries e
       where e.concept_id=c.id and e.status='ready_for_review');
  select id into v_active_batch from public.editorial_legacy_batches
   where status in ('queued','running','paused') limit 1;
  return jsonb_build_object('eligible_count',v_count,
    'active_batch_id',v_active_batch,'configured',coalesce(p_configured,false));
end
$function$

  select jsonb_typeof(p_quality)='object'
    and (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(p_quality))=9
    and p_quality->'factual_accuracy'='true'::jsonb
    and p_quality->'usefulness'='true'::jsonb
    and p_quality->'clarity'='true'::jsonb

    and p_quality->>'sensitive_topic_handling' in ('not_applicable','reviewed')

edge_api_editorial_queue.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_queue(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_aal text, p_kind text, p_status text, p_topic_id uuid, p_assignee_id uuid, p_subtopic_id uuid, p_urgency text, p_search text, p_cursor uuid, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor jsonb;
  v_total bigint;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_next uuid;
begin
  if p_kind is null or p_kind not in ('revisions','legacy','published')
     or p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 100
     or p_search is null or length(p_search) > 120
     or (p_status is not null and p_status not in (
       'generating','draft','validation_failed','pending_review',
       'changes_requested','approved','rejected','published','retired'))
     or (p_urgency is not null and p_urgency not in (
       'overdue','scheduled','unscheduled')) then
    return jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid_page');
  end if;
  if p_kind <> 'revisions' and (p_status is not null or p_assignee_id is not null
     or p_urgency is not null) then
    return jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid_filter');
  end if;
  v_actor := public.edge_api_editorial_authorize_any(
    p_user_id, p_session_id, p_aal, array['review','approve','publish']);
  if v_actor ? 'error' then return v_actor; end if;

  with filtered as (
    select rrow.id, to_jsonb(rrow) as item from (
      select r.id,r.concept_id,c.slug,r.body->>'title' as title,r.status,
        r.base_version,r.assigned_to,r.review_due_at,r.created_at,c.content_version,
        t.name as topic_name,s.name as subtopic_name,c.topic_id,c.subtopic_id,
        (select e.registered_name from public.editorial_revision_events e
          where e.revision_id=r.id and e.action='approved' limit 1) as approved_by,
        (r.review_due_at<statement_timestamp() and r.status not in ('published','retired')) as overdue
      from public.concept_revisions r join public.concepts c on c.id=r.concept_id
      join public.topics t on t.id=c.topic_id
      join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where p_kind='revisions'
        and ((p_status is not null and r.status=p_status)
          or (p_status is null and r.status not in ('published','retired')))
        and (p_topic_id is null or c.topic_id=p_topic_id)
        and (p_subtopic_id is null or c.subtopic_id=p_subtopic_id)
        and (p_assignee_id is null or r.assigned_to=p_assignee_id)
        and (p_urgency is null or
          (p_urgency='overdue' and r.review_due_at<statement_timestamp()
            and r.status not in ('published','retired')) or
          (p_urgency='scheduled' and r.review_due_at>=statement_timestamp()
            and r.status not in ('published','retired')) or
          (p_urgency='unscheduled' and r.review_due_at is null))
        and (p_search='' or strpos(lower(coalesce(r.body->>'title',c.title)),lower(p_search))>0)
    ) rrow
    union all
    select lrow.id, to_jsonb(lrow) from (
      select c.id,c.slug,c.title,c.content_version,t.name as topic_name,
        s.name as subtopic_name,c.topic_id,c.subtopic_id,c.status,
        (l.snapshot=to_jsonb(c)-array['created_at','published_at','status']) as unchanged
      from public.editorial_legacy_versions l join public.concepts c
        on l.concept_id=c.id and l.content_version=c.content_version
      join public.topics t on t.id=c.topic_id
      join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where p_kind='legacy' and c.status='published'
        and not exists(select 1 from public.editorial_publications p
          where p.concept_id=c.id and p.content_version=c.content_version)
        and (p_topic_id is null or c.topic_id=p_topic_id)
        and (p_subtopic_id is null or c.subtopic_id=p_subtopic_id)
        and (p_search='' or strpos(lower(c.title),lower(p_search))>0)
    ) lrow
    union all
    select prow.id, to_jsonb(prow) from (
      select c.id,c.slug,c.title,c.content_version,t.name as topic_name,
        s.name as subtopic_name,c.topic_id,c.subtopic_id,c.status,
        true as verified,
        (select e.registered_name from public.editorial_revision_events e
          where e.id=p.approval_id) as approved_by
      from public.editorial_publications p join public.concepts c
        on p.concept_id=c.id and p.content_version=c.content_version
      join public.topics t on t.id=c.topic_id
      join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
      where p_kind='published' and c.status='published'
        and p.snapshot=to_jsonb(c)-array['created_at','published_at','status']
        and (p_topic_id is null or c.topic_id=p_topic_id)
        and (p_subtopic_id is null or c.subtopic_id=p_subtopic_id)
        and (p_search='' or strpos(lower(c.title),lower(p_search))>0)
    ) prow
  ), page as (
    select id,item from filtered where p_cursor is null or id>p_cursor
    order by id limit p_limit + 1
  ), numbered as (
    select page.*,row_number() over(order by id) as position from page
  )
  select (select count(*) from filtered),
         coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by id) filter(where position<=p_limit), '[]'::jsonb),
         (select id from numbered where position=p_limit
           and exists(select 1 from numbered where position>p_limit))
    into v_total,v_items,v_next from numbered;
  return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'total',v_total,'next_cursor',v_next);
end
$function$

edge_api_editorial_revision_detail_sourc.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_editorial_revision_detail_source(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_aal text, p_revision_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor jsonb;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  v_actor := public.edge_api_editorial_authorize_any(
    p_user_id,p_session_id,p_aal,array['review','approve','publish']);
  if v_actor ? 'error' then return v_actor; end if;
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'revision',to_jsonb(r),
    'content_version',c.content_version,
    'concept_status',c.status,
    'topic_active',t.is_active,
    'subtopic_active',s.is_active,
    'subtopic_slug',s.slug,
    'source_snapshot',to_jsonb(c)-array['created_at','published_at','status'],
    'source_body',jsonb_build_object(
      'title',c.title,'summary',c.summary,'example',c.example,
      'curriculum',c.curriculum,'subtopic_slug',s.slug,
      'model',c.model,'prompt_version',c.prompt_version,
      'learning_package',jsonb_build_object('flashcard',c.flashcard,'mcqs',c.mcqs)),
    'base_snapshot',case when r.status in ('published','retired') then
      coalesce(
        (select e.source_snapshot from public.editorial_revision_events e
          where e.revision_id=r.id and e.base_version=r.base_version
            and e.source_snapshot->>'content_version'=r.base_version::text
          order by (e.action='approved') desc,e.created_at,e.id limit 1),
        (select p.snapshot from public.editorial_publications p
          where p.concept_id=r.concept_id and p.content_version=r.base_version),
        (select l.snapshot from public.editorial_legacy_versions l
          where l.concept_id=r.concept_id and l.content_version=r.base_version))
      else null end,
    'approved_by',(select e.registered_name from public.editorial_revision_events e
      where e.revision_id=r.id and e.action='approved' limit 1),
    'unknown_prerequisite',(select prereq.slug from
      jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(r.body->'curriculum'->'prerequisites')='array'
        then r.body->'curriculum'->'prerequisites' else '[]'::jsonb end)
      with ordinality prereq(slug,position)
      where not exists(select 1 from public.concepts known where known.slug=prereq.slug)
        and not exists(select 1 from public.concept_backlog known where known.slug=prereq.slug)
      order by prereq.position limit 1),
    'unpublished_prerequisite',(select prereq.slug from
      jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(r.body->'curriculum'->'prerequisites')='array'
        then r.body->'curriculum'->'prerequisites' else '[]'::jsonb end)
      with ordinality prereq(slug,position)
      where not exists(select 1 from public.concepts required
        join public.topics rt on rt.id=required.topic_id and rt.is_active
        join public.subtopics rs on rs.id=required.subtopic_id and rs.is_active
        where required.slug=prereq.slug and required.status='published')
      order by prereq.position limit 1),
    'duplicate_slug',(select other.slug from public.concepts other
      where other.id<>c.id and other.status='published' and (
        pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(other.title),
          '[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')) =
        pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(r.body->>'title'),
          '[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g'))
        or pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
          pg_catalog.lower(other.curriculum->>'objective'),'[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')) =
          pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
          pg_catalog.lower(r.body->'curriculum'->>'objective'),'[^[:alnum:]_]+',' ','g')))
      order by other.slug limit 1)
  ) into v_result
    from public.concept_revisions r
    join public.concepts c on c.id=r.concept_id
    join public.topics t on t.id=c.topic_id
    join public.subtopics s on s.id=c.subtopic_id
    where r.id=p_revision_id;
  if v_result is null then return jsonb_build_object('error','revision_not_found'); end if;
  return v_result;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_history(p_user_id uuid, p_before date, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with page as materialized (
    select a.concept_id, a.assigned_for
      from public.daily_assignments a
      join public.concepts c on c.id = a.concept_id and c.status = 'published'
     where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.completed_at is not null
       and (p_before is null or a.assigned_for < p_before)
     order by a.assigned_for desc
     limit p_limit + 1
  ), numbered as (
    select page.*, row_number() over (order by assigned_for desc) as position
      from page
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'concept_slug', c.slug,
        'learned_on', n.assigned_for,
        'title', c.title,
        'topic_name', t.name,
        'like_count', (
          select count(*)::integer from public.concept_interactions ci
          where ci.concept_id = n.concept_id and ci.liked_at is not null
            and ci.user_id <> p_user_id
        )
      ) order by n.assigned_for desc)
      from numbered n
      join public.concepts c on c.id = n.concept_id
      join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
      where n.position <= p_limit
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next_cursor', case when exists(select 1 from numbered where position > p_limit)
      then (select assigned_for::text from numbered where position = p_limit)
      else null end
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_record_subtopic_completion(p_user_id uuid, p_concept_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with target as (
    select s.id, s.slug as subtopic_slug, s.name as subtopic_name,
           t.slug as topic_slug, t.name as topic_name
      from public.concepts focus
      join public.subtopics s on s.id = focus.subtopic_id and s.is_active
      join public.topics t on t.id = s.topic_id and t.is_active
     where focus.id = p_concept_id
  ), catalog as (
    select target.*, array_agg(c.id order by c.id) as ids, count(*)::integer as available
      from target join public.concepts c on c.subtopic_id = target.id and c.status = 'published'
     group by target.id, target.subtopic_slug, target.subtopic_name,
              target.topic_slug, target.topic_name
  ), covered as (
    select catalog.*, count(done.concept_id)::integer as completed
      from catalog left join public.user_concept_completions done
        on done.user_id = p_user_id and done.concept_id = any(catalog.ids)
     group by catalog.id, catalog.subtopic_slug, catalog.subtopic_name,
              catalog.topic_slug, catalog.topic_name, catalog.ids, catalog.available
  ), inserted as (
    insert into public.user_subtopic_completions
      (user_id, subtopic_id, catalog_signature, catalog_concept_ids)
    select p_user_id, id,
           md5(array_to_string(covered.ids, ',')) ||
             md5('one-concept-subtopic-v1:' || array_to_string(covered.ids, ',')),
           ids from covered where available > 0 and completed = available
    on conflict(user_id, subtopic_id, catalog_signature) do nothing
    returning id, subtopic_id, completed_at
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', inserted.id, 'topic_slug', covered.topic_slug,
    'topic_name', covered.topic_name,
    'subtopic_slug', covered.subtopic_slug,
    'subtopic_name', covered.subtopic_name,
    'completed_at', inserted.completed_at)
    from inserted join covered on covered.id = inserted.subtopic_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_set_notifications(p_user_id uuid, p_enabled boolean, p_weekly boolean, p_times text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_times time[];
begin
  if p_enabled is null or p_times is null or cardinality(p_times) not between 1 and 3
     or exists (
       select 1 from unnest(p_times) value
       where value is null or value !~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
     ) then
    raise exception 'Invalid notification preferences';
  end if;
  select array_agg(distinct value::time order by value::time) into v_times
  from unnest(p_times) value;
  update public.notification_preferences
     set enabled = p_enabled,
         weekly_quiz_enabled = coalesce(p_weekly, weekly_quiz_enabled),
         reminder_times = v_times
   where user_id = p_user_id;
  return public.edge_api_notifications(p_user_id);
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_signal_supply(p_user_id uuid, p_topic_id uuid, p_low integer, p_reserve integer, p_active_days integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with inventory as (
    select count(*)::integer as published,
      count(*) filter (where exists (
        select 1 from public.daily_assignments a
         where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.concept_id = c.id
      ))::integer as assigned
      from public.concepts c
      join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
      join public.subtopics s on s.id = c.subtopic_id and s.is_active
     where c.topic_id = p_topic_id and c.status = 'published' and t.is_active
  )
  insert into public.content_supply_targets(topic_id, target_count, expires_at)
  select p_topic_id, assigned + p_reserve, now() + make_interval(days => p_active_days)
    from inventory where published - assigned <= p_low
      and exists(select 1 from public.topics where id = p_topic_id and is_active)
  on conflict(topic_id) do update set
    target_count = greatest(
      case when content_supply_targets.expires_at > now()
        then content_supply_targets.target_count else 0 end,
      excluded.target_count),
    requested_at = now(), expires_at = excluded.expires_at
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_stats(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with user_day as (
    select (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today
    from public.profiles where id = p_user_id
  ), days as (
    select assigned_for as d from public.daily_assignments
    where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    union
    select assigned_for from public.daily_reviews
    where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
  ), grouped as (
    select d, d - (row_number() over (order by d))::int as grp from days
  ), runs as (
    select grp, count(*)::int as len, max(d) as ends_on
    from grouped group by grp
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'current', coalesce((
      select len from runs where ends_on in (user_day.today, user_day.today - 1)
      order by ends_on desc limit 1
    ), 0),
    'longest', coalesce((select max(len) from runs), 0),
    'total_learned', (
      select count(*)::int from public.daily_assignments
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    ),
    'total_reviews', (
      select count(*)::int from public.daily_reviews
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    )
  )
  from user_day
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_subtopic_progress(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with catalog as (
    select t.slug as topic_slug, t.name as topic_name,
           s.id as subtopic_id, s.slug as subtopic_slug, s.name as subtopic_name,
           array_agg(c.id order by c.id) as ids, count(*)::integer as available
      from public.topics t
      join public.subtopics s on s.topic_id = t.id and s.is_active
      join public.concepts c on c.subtopic_id = s.id and c.status = 'published'
     where t.is_active
     group by t.slug, t.name, s.id, s.slug, s.name
  ), progress as (
    select catalog.*, count(done.concept_id)::integer as completed_concepts
      from catalog
      left join public.user_concept_completions done
        on done.user_id = p_user_id and done.concept_id = any(catalog.ids)
     group by catalog.topic_slug, catalog.topic_name, catalog.subtopic_id,
              catalog.subtopic_slug, catalog.subtopic_name, catalog.ids, catalog.available
  ), resolved as (
    select progress.*,
           (select event.id from public.user_subtopic_completions event
             where event.user_id = p_user_id and event.subtopic_id = progress.subtopic_id
               and event.catalog_signature =
                 md5(array_to_string(progress.ids, ',')) ||
                 md5('one-concept-subtopic-v1:' || array_to_string(progress.ids, ','))
           ) as completion_id
      from progress
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('items', coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'topic_slug', topic_slug, 'topic_name', topic_name,
      'subtopic_slug', subtopic_slug, 'subtopic_name', subtopic_name,
      'completed_concepts', completed_concepts, 'available_concepts', available,
      'completed', completion_id is not null, 'completion_id', completion_id
    ) order by topic_name, subtopic_name
  ), '[]'::jsonb))
    from resolved

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, display_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name', split_part(new.email, '@', 1))
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  insert into public.notification_preferences (user_id)
  values (new.id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  -- Follow every active topic by default, matching the app's current behaviour.
  insert into public.user_topics (user_id, topic_id)
  select new.id, t.id from public.topics t where t.is_active
  on conflict do nothing;

  return new;
end;

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
begin
  if (new.body,new.concept_id,new.base_version) is distinct from
     (old.body,old.concept_id,old.base_version)
     and exists(select 1 from public.editorial_revision_events where revision_id=old.id) then
    raise exception 'Reviewed revisions are immutable; create a new revision';

end $function$
